How does it work?

1. Pick a restaurant and choose your meal from their menu.
2. Select the order type and time to get your order. 
3. Pay in advance directly through the app and your food will be ready on time.

At the Table ordering is our specialty.

Our motto is Arrive and eat! No need to stare at other guests' meals, wave to get the waiter or wait until the food is prepared. Thanks to PayToEat, you know exactly when to arrive and the food is already waiting for you, nicely fresh and with just the right temperature so that you can immediately start eating. And since you already paid when ordering, you can leave any time without any more waiting. The option At the Table also works as a table reservation. Ordering Take Away is equally straightforward.

How long does it take to process the order?

You can either pick a specific time or order with the option As Soon As Possible and the restaurant will start preparing your food immediately.
